name: Filter bar
summary: A row above a list with a search field and filter dropdowns; active filters show inside each dropdown trigger.
useWhen: Above a table or list that people search and filter.

dontUseWhen.case: A single search field with no filters

dontUseWhen.use: a side panel with a form

anatomy.description: Flex row that wraps on narrow screens. Dropdown triggers inside it match the 40px input height.
Put this class on the gds-input wrapper of the search field: it grows up to 360px.
"Clear filters" ghost button, pushed to the right. Show it only when a filter is active.

states.name: filter active
states.how: Show the choice in the trigger value ("Status: Published") and show gds-filter-bar__clear.

a11y: Give the bar role="search" and an aria-label.
The search input needs an aria-label (no visible label in a filter bar).
Each dropdown trigger names its filter and current value.

rules.rule: The search field uses gds-input gds-input--md together with gds-filter-bar__search.
rules.why: The bar aligns controls to the md height.

rules.rule: Show an active filter inside its dropdown trigger ("Status: Published"), not as a separate row of badges.
rules.why: Design decision (11 Nov 2026): keeps the bar to one row.

rules.rule: The bar has role="search" and an aria-label.
rules.why: Lets screen reader users find the filters.

knownIssues.issue: Outside the filter bar, dropdown triggers are still shorter than md inputs.
knownIssues.fix: v3: shared control heights for all components.

examples.name: Search and two filters
